local function parse_simple_csv(line)
    local fields = {}
    for field in (line .. ","):gmatch("(.-),") do
        field = field:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        table.insert(fields, field)
    end
    if #fields ~= 3 then return nil, "expected three fields" end
    local score = tonumber(fields[3])
    if not score then return nil, "score must be numeric" end
    return { name = fields[1], city = fields[2], score = score }
end
local row, err = parse_simple_csv("Mina,Ahmedabad,88")
if row then print(row.name, row.score) else print(err) end
-- This deliberately does not parse quoted fields containing commas.
